html: Step away for a while and do something completely unrelated to your project: sport, karaoke, travel, whatever works. Come back once you’ve calmed down and can look at the project rationally, ready to work out what’s feasible as a next step. Otherwise, if you keep staring at it while you’re feeling low, it will only look more hopeless, and however much time you put in, you’ll get half the result for twice the effort.
